inputs.text: This Harry Wait situation in Wisconsin is straight up the hidden elites and their institutional puppets coordinating to crush anyone who dares expose how they control and manipulate the election process. A Racine County jury on Tuesday slapped him with two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft conviction after a quick two-day trial, all because he requested ballots for Robin Vos and Cory Mason without their say-so. They let him off on the second identity theft count, but that doesn't change the fact that he's been leading the charge to expose how rigged and vulnerable the whole system is. Back in 2022 he straight up admitted he did it to show the state's voter registration setup can be gamed easily, yet here they are railroading him like he's the criminal for revealing the truth. You know this is coordinated from the top—both sides of the aisle involved with Vos and Mason—to protect their narrative and bury any real proof of how fake these elections can be.
